title: Install qteasy and optional TA-Lib
summary: pip install qteasy on Python >=3.9 and <3.13. TA-Lib needs the C library before the Python wrapper.
narrative:
Install qteasy with pip into Python >=3.9 and <3.13. A dedicated virtual environment avoids clashes with other packages. `pip install qteasy` is the base install. Upgrade with `pip install qteasy --upgrade`. If the download is slow, point pip at a domestic index.

Optional pieces are separate from the base install. Use a local MySQL database only if you want the database store instead of files. Install TA-Lib only if you want the built-in technical indicators.

TA-Lib: `pip install ta-lib` installs only the Python wrapper. Install the C library first, for example `conda install -c conda-forge libta-lib`, or a system package such as Homebrew `ta-lib` on macOS. Then install the Python package. Without the C library, importing the indicators fails. This card does not list every operating-system command.
risk_notes: Installing packages changes the Python environment. This card does not run pip for you.
